title: Exercise
description: JSON document schema for a Pilates exercise stored in Azure Cosmos DB and served by the API

id.description: Unique identifier for the exercise document in Cosmos DB (e.g., 'PIL-CORE-001')

name.description: Display name of the Pilates exercise

muscleGroup.description: Primary muscle group or anatomical area targeted by the exercise

equipment.description: Required equipment to perform the exercise (mat, bands, ball, none, reformer, weights). Can be an array or a single string.

duration.description: Standard duration of the exercise in seconds (typically 30-120 seconds)

instructions.description: Clear step-by-step execution instructions and form cues for the exercise

category.description: Functional Pilates category from the exercise dataset

targetMuscles.description: Specific muscles activated during the exercise

difficultyLabel.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the numeric difficulty level

focus.description: Workout routine focus classification used for matching and routine generation

reps.description: Recommended repetition range or breath cycle count per set

keyCue.description: Concise verbal cue for quick reference during active workout playback

_etag.description: Cosmos DB entity tag for optimistic concurrency

_ts.description: Cosmos DB timestamp (seconds since Unix epoch)
